header: Why we stopped rebuilding the same components
lead: Every new site needed the same heroes, cards and pricing tables, built from scratch and never audited. We decided to build them once, for everyone.
body: We want TYPO3 editors to have the UI quality that shadcn/ui gave React developers. So we built Desiderio: 244 content elements in 10 groups, 62 Fluid components and 15 theme presets. A preset changes the whole site at runtime, dark mode included, without a rebuild. The core is GPL-licensed and free, because the TYPO3 community gave us our start. The same team installs, hosts and adapts Desiderio for teams who want help from the people who built it.
